summary: Iteration 37 — Audit version Sénégal SANS Stripe. 14/14 tests passed (100%). All 5 Stripe-backed endpoints properly return 503 (never 500/404) with French wording mentioning Wave/Orange Money/espèces. GET /api/payments/config returns the exact required payload (card=false, card_ready=false, wave/orange/cash=true, wave_ready=false, orange_ready=false, currency=XOF, country=SN). Wave & Orange sponsorship checkouts return 503 gracefully as expected (empty keys), each with a French message referencing the missing WAVE_API_KEY / OM_CLIENT_ID env vars. Non-regression fully green: admin/client/pro login, /providers?limit=5, POST /bookings (client with fixed prestation), GET /dashboard (pro), GET /admin/company-info (admin) all 200.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_require_stripe() implementation is clean: HTTPException(503) with a French, user-facing message. All 5 Stripe callsites correctly use `except HTTPException: raise` before the generic Exception handler, so the 503 is preserved (not re-wrapped as 500).
payments_local.py raises 503 with clear French message referencing WAVE_API_KEY / OM_CLIENT_ID when creds are empty — expected & tested.
Note: /api/payments/status/{sid} raises 503 via _require_stripe() BEFORE reaching the 404 branch — matches the spec (Stripe globally disabled ⇒ 503, not 404).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ booking created via POST /api/bookings (client@jokoo.sn) against an existing seeded provider + fixed prestation. No manual DB seeding required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth response uses key `token` (not `access_token`). Client bookings are fetched via GET /api/bookings/{id} (there is no /bookings/mine). Sponsorship POST /api/sponsorships requires role=prestataire and duration_days in {7,15,30}. For Stripe-off testing, STRIPE_API_KEY must remain empty in /app/backend/.env — no restart needed if the backend was already started with it empty.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Version Sénégal sans Stripe est fonctionnelle et l'audit passe intégralement.
